record_type: Full reference-ID accounting and scoped engineering-family review
authority: The issue tracker owns subsequent implementation status. Source IDs join to the immutable ledger. A family disposition does not establish function-level numerical equivalence.

disposition_definitions.duplicate: Duplicate identity under the frozen ledger rule. See duplicate_of in that ledger.
disposition_definitions.stub: The frozen definition was classified as a placeholder.
disposition_definitions.selected-operation: Source named in this baseline gap audit. Refer to the operation-specific limits and oracle.
disposition_definitions.earlier-qualified-workflow: A named source in an earlier verification receipt. Qualification applies only to its stated domain.
disposition_definitions.broader-domain: Reviewed source for one of four separate application or measurement domains.
disposition_definitions.test-or-example: Source fixture, test case, setup or example. Supplies evidence rather than a separate implementation requirement.
disposition_definitions.earlier-scoped-capability: Earlier record linked a tested capability within its stated domain. Numerical equivalence of this definition remains unverified.
disposition_definitions.reference-format-or-assumptions: Archived source has special inputs, format, assumptions, or a defective implementation. Consult its capability and replacement limits.
disposition_definitions.source-needs-independent-oracle: Historical parse limitation in the frozen capability record. Members include constructors, a zero-return stub, analytical equations and a broken translation. See the historical cohort and subsequent per-ID audit before interpreting this class.
disposition_definitions.framework-or-representation: Construction, representation or data-model metadata in its original system. No distinct engineering calculation inferred from this record.
disposition_definitions.outside-selected-application: Source is in a project-specific design, external circuit simulator, converter library or standards subsystem. Its individual behavior was not independently qualified.
disposition_definitions.individual-behavior-unreviewed: No stronger operation-level assessment was established. The family is mapped and the individual behavior remains unreviewed.
disposition_definitions.circuit-platform-context: General circuit data model, dispatch, results, plotting, persistence, or batch simulator interface. There is no claim of equivalent project orchestration.
disposition_definitions.passive-component-context: A passive-component or EMI-receiver subsystem rather than a semiconductor calculation. Specific physical or standards evidence is separate.
disposition_definitions.repository-and-tooling-context: Repository/configuration/CLI/documentation/release utilities. The implementation language and storage service are not semiconductor capabilities.
disposition_definitions.generic-signal-container: Generic signal storage, vector arithmetic, plotting, sample statistics or signal-processing facade. Earlier qualified waveform capabilities are stated separately. Per-method numerical equivalence unverified.
disposition_definitions.generic-lut-framework: Reference lookup-table construction, cleaning or extrapolation. Existing bounded condition tables cover a different, stated domain. Numerical parity unverified.
disposition_definitions.reference-device-accessor: Reference device metadata or condition-specific component interface. The corresponding native device concept exists. Serialization and method-level equivalence unverified.
disposition_definitions.specialized-calibration-unverified: Reference model training, series filtering or reconstruction depends on calibration metadata or a separately qualified signal-processing rule.
disposition_definitions.reference-numeric-helper: Nearest-sample utility found in SC. Choosing the nearest existing sample is a local numerical operation, not an independent semiconductor workflow or a substitute for condition-matched interpolation.

operation_qualifications.spectrum-mask: Also compare RMS or mean-square within explicit frequency bands from all normalized bins. Equivalent to neither joules nor a regulatory receiver measurement. See the family annex.
operation_qualifications.continuous-temperature-diode-fit: Separate optional fixed-condition bilinear model with rank-four training data and four observed rectangle corners. Enforce positive current slope at both temperature limits and nonnegative forward voltage at all corners. Invert only inside each temperature-specific voltage interval. Held-out observations do not extend support. A synthetic fit establishes algorithm behavior; named-device prediction accuracy needs independent data.

additional_family_review: All source IDs have a scope disposition. The 19+16 original qualification cohorts are preserved separately from current operation assignments. See qualification_refinements for the source-body cross-check and existing bridgeless preset.

sc-b49c7a95ee0fe10d.source_behavior: The valid MATLAB implementation aggregates semiconductor losses for supplied waveforms. The archived Python translation is invalid.
sc-b49c7a95ee0fe10d.remaining_limit: Historical MATLAB waveform loading, recorded source accuracy and active-path assumptions remain input and model qualifications. No missing named PFC preset or independent waveform generator was established.

qualification_refinements.sc-biela-18: This historical parser bucket includes data classes, constructors and a zero-return placeholder. transistordatabase/biela.py already implements qualified analytical equations. Nineteen parse-limited entries do not imply nineteen missing engineering operations.
qualification_refinements.enco-16: The source cohort includes storage wrappers, model training, statistics and signal conditioning. Only the independently supported subset of median, circular shift, rolling detrend and additional Fourier windows is included in operation 11.
